transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm here because I've been feeling extremely depressed and completely drained of energy for the last three months. I'm constantly exhausted, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy, empty feeling. It has gotten to the point where even getting through the day feels impossible.
Have you felt depressed or down for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two years?
No, I haven't felt like this for two years. This deep depression and feeling completely down only started about three months ago. Before that, things were very different.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yes, I have. Over the last few months, I've completely stopped caring about the hobbies and activities I used to love. Nothing brings me any joy or pleasure anymore, and everything just feels completely flat.
Have you had any thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of wanting to die or hurting myself. Even though I feel incredibly down and exhausted, I've never thought about ending my life.
Have you been having trouble sleeping, sleeping too much, or waking up earlier than usual?
I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep patterns lately. I think I've been sleeping about the same as usual, so I'm not really sure if there is any difference.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over the last few months?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my appetite or weight recently. My eating habits and weight have stayed pretty much the same over these past few months.
Have you been feeling unusually guilty, worthless, or like a failure?
No, I wouldn't say I feel guilty or like a failure. It's more that I just feel completely exhausted and empty inside most of the time.
Have you been having trouble concentrating, making decisions, or thinking as clearly as usual?

Yes, my thinking has felt really foggy and dazed over the past three months, and I find it very hard to concentrate on daily tasks. I've also been struggling a lot with making even simple, minor decisions that used to be effortless.
Based on the information so far, the presentation is most consistent with Major Depressive Disorder.

I understand why it seems that way, but before this depression, I had a distinct three-week period where I felt completely the opposite. I had overflowing energy, racing thoughts, and got extremely irritable, and I even started seeing and hearing things that weren't actually there. Because of that intense phase, I'm worried it might be something more than just depression.
Have you ever had hallucinations or delusions when you were not feeling depressed or manic?

No, I've never had those experiences when my mood was normal or when I was depressed. The hallucinations and strange beliefs only happened during that three-week period when I was feeling extremely high, hyperactive, and full of energy.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a distinct 3-week manic episode with markedly increased energy, racing thoughts, irritability, hyperactivity, and hallucinations/delusional beliefs occurring only during the mood episode. He then developed a 3-month major depressive episode with low mood, anhedonia, fatigue, and impaired concentration. There is no evidence of psychotic symptoms outside mood episodes, making schizoaffective disorder less likely and supporting Bipolar I Disorder with psychotic features.
